title: State of Jharkhand v. Pradeep Kumar Mandal & Ors. (Jamtara Phishing Syndicate)
crime_type: Cyber Vishing / SIM Swapping / Fraudulent UPI Banking Extraction
court_or_authority: District & Sessions Court, Jamtara / High Court of Jharkhand
legal_citation: Sessions Trial No. 114/2021; 2022 SCC OnLine Jhar 743
source: Jharkhand High Court Judgment & Indian Kanoon (doc/18294723)
ipc_sections: Section 420 IPC (Cheating and dishonestly inducing delivery of property)
evidence: Recovery of 84 forged SIM cards activated under fake Aadhaar credentials and 47 smart handsets from rural forest hideouts
Audio recordings of social engineering phone calls impersonating bank KYC verification officers and SBI customer care executives
Bank passbooks showing micro-transfers to wallet accounts immediately cashed out at rural CSP kiosks
Call detail logs tracing thousands of unsolicited outbound calls originating from specific mobile BTS towers in Jamtara
modus_operandi: Purchased thousands of pre-activated SIM cards using counterfeit identity documents. Operated makeshift call centers in forest groves, mass-dialing phone numbers across India posing as banking executives warning of impending debit card or electricity disconnection. Coerced victims into revealing OTPs or downloading remote access applications (AnyDesk/TeamViewer).
personality_disorder: Predatory opportunism, emotional detachment from victim suffering, and criminal group conformity.
common_traits: Voice phishing (vishing) posing as official bank managers
Fabricating false urgency regarding account suspension
Instant dissipation through rural payment banks and wallets
summary: Key trial establishing systemic cyber enforcement precedents against Jamtara based syndicates. Led to nationwide coordination between state cyber police units and telecom operators for real-time IMEI blacklisting.
